description:
Outcome: Board updates automatically every ten seconds, from owner requirement and explicit request for a separate auto-refresh ticket.
Scope: Periodic fetch through V1 state/render interface; no overlapping requests; prevent stale/out-of-order overwrites; stale-data indicator; retry/reconnection; dispose timers/requests. Preserve V1 day-expiry clearing and never restore expired data. Excludes: new board layout/projection, operator polling and SMS.
Acceptance: Next successful polling cycle reflects additions/claims/completions; ten-second cadence when no request is in flight; skip slow-request overlaps; visible stale state during outage; successful poll recovers; expired-day payload never restores names.
Behaviour: Failed polls preserve only valid same-day display with stale indicator; expiry clears even disconnected; page disposal stops timers and requests.
Verification: Fake-clock tests for cadence, overlap, out-of-order replies, outage/recovery, disposal and integrated polling across midnight. Prerequisites: V1 board page. Assumptions: ten-second interval, no update-latency guarantee while network fails.
Setup label: V2.
title: Board auto-refresh
